'''Chav wine''' was a type of [[Wine/Legends|wine]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] considered it to be contraband. The [[ZeHethbra]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Clyngunn]] once smuggled a shipment of chav wine when he was intercepted by a customs boarding party. The [[Customs official/Legends|customs official]] in command was an amateur [[Athlete/Legends|athlete]] and recognized Clyngunn, who was a famed athlete holding the record for most [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] defeated in his class of the [[Multi-Sentient Unarmed Combat Rounds]] at the [[Stratis Games]]. In exchange for Clyngunn's autograph, the official overlooked the infraction.<ref name="TLCSB" />
